about_the_game:
About This Game

Core Experience

Knowledge Starification:

Classics, poetry and other knowledge are restructured into a dynamic cosmic structure - from the "Grand Master Galaxy" to the "Investigation of Things and Acquisition of Knowledge Star System", delving deeper layer by layer. Each planet represents an independent knowledge module (such as a chapter of "The Art of War"), and spatial coordinates are used to enhance memory.

Immersive Learning Engine:

• Free Exploration: WASD movement + mouse for perspective control, wander among knowledge planets

• Interactive Learning: Click on the "Knowledge Blackboard" to view the original text, pinyin, annotations, and multimedia explanations (as shown in Figure 1)

• Data-driven: Intelligent tables dynamically manage massive texts to ensure precise content updates (as shown in Figure 2)

Innovative design

Cognitive training system:

Based on spatial memory algorithms, it associates abstract knowledge with three-dimensional coordinates, enhancing memory efficiency by 300% (internal test data).

Seamless cross-platform synchronization:

Continue your journey of knowledge exploration across Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, and Linux devices.

Content ecosystem

The Multidisciplinary Knowledge Galaxy:

The "Teaching Area", "Poetry Star Region", "Military Strategy Universe", and other zones have been opened, with continuous expansion into disciplines such as philosophy and history.

Deep content interaction:

For instance, the "Sun Tzu's Art of War" planet contains over 75 interactive nodes, combining battle case animations and strategic simulations (as shown in Figure 3), bringing ancient classics to life.

Future Vision

We will build a "universe of all human knowledge" - users can customize their own knowledge planets, share learning maps, and ultimately form a decentralized cognitive network. Join this cognitive revolution and make learning an interstellar adventure!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD FX 8320
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
